description: This file is a markdown document providing an extensive overview and specifications for the HDMIOutput HAL interface in a device or system. It details the interface design, capabilities, states, event handling, feature profiles, and usage scenarios for HDMI output control, including video modes, HDCP, HDR, aspect ratio management, and platform capabilities.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Defines the supported features, formats, protocols, and capabilities of the HDMI output resource, including supported versions, VICs, colorimetry, HDCP, HDR modes, infoframes, and advanced features.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the set of capabilities supported by the HDMI output, including supported resolutions, color modes, HDR support, HDCP versions, and more.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the HDMI output signal, including HDCP authentication and link training.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the HDMI output signal, terminating video transmission.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HDMI output resource, releasing any held resources.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes/opens the HDMI output for use, preparing for video output and HDCP authentication.
